verdict.rationale: The docs offer only indirect support for long-lived sessions: a stable ID lets you reconnect to the same sandbox (docs-37), background processes can be managed (docs-43), and storage can persist across sandbox lifecycles via mounted buckets and R2 snapshots (docs-7, docs-48). A community report notes containers auto-shut down when they stop receiving requests (comm-5), and how the filesystem persists through idle states is unclear (comm-4), so multi-hour or multi-day continuous running is never documented. Missing for 10: a documented maximum session duration or keep-alive option, an explicit guarantee that sandboxes run for hours or days without idle shutdown, and hands-on corroboration of long agent runs.
